operation_metadata.purpose: Correct live Custom Format scoring so that unmeasured AV1 groups (Bi0hazard, Waldek, SHADOW, etc.) are strictly in Tier 4 below Tier 3 x265 while remaining >= 1001 grabbable

Tier 1 (Preferred AV1).behavior: Top priority selection; wins over all other tiers.

Tier 2 (Review AV1 Fallback).behavior: Secondary fallback; wins over x265 when Tier 1 is absent.
Tier 2 (Review AV1 Fallback).guardrails: AV1 Lean 2160p penalty (-3400) demotes undersized releases below x265.

Tier 3 (Reference x265 Fallback).behavior: High-fidelity baseline; wins over failing Review AV1 and all Tier 4 unmeasured AV1.

Tier 4 (Last Resort / Quarantined AV1).behavior: Quarantined below Tier 3 x265, but >= 1001 so grabbable as last resort when no Tier 1/2/3 release exists.
